statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known sick sinus syndrome
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
A cardiac event monitor (CPT 93271) is ordered
The service is to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of symptoms
The service is to assess for correlation between cardiac rhythm disturbances and neurological history
The diagnosis codes are Z86.73, I49.5, and R42
The denial reason code is CO-97
The denial is based on the service being bundled into another covered procedure
No separate reimbursement is authorized for this line item
